components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary commitment action using decoupled cobalt fill with WCAG AA dark-on-cobalt contrast in dark mode.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #5b95ff); background: var(--accent, #5b95ff); color: var(--accent-fg, #080a0d); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, transform 80ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, #79aaff); border-color: var(--accent-hover, #79aaff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5b95ff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0.5px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default desk control resting on surface with hairline perimeter.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(255,255,255,0.085)); background: var(--surface, #12151b); color: var(--ink, #eef2f6); font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--elevated, #191d26); border-color: rgba(238,242,246,0.22); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5b95ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Interactive 6px micro-radius toggle chip with tinted selected state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; min-height: 26px; padding: 2px 9px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(255,255,255,0.085)); background: transparent; color: var(--ink-2, #b4becc); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--elevated, #191d26); color: var(--ink, #eef2f6); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: rgba(91,149,255,0.14); border-color: rgba(91,149,255,0.52); color: var(--ink, #eef2f6); font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #5b95ff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Navigation
components.description: Ordered four-stage workflow switcher inside a recessed 8px track.

narrative.northStar: The Precision Quantitative Terminal × Institutional IC Memo
narrative.overview: T3 Trading Desk is an authenticated Operate-mode workbench built for medium-to-long-horizon (1Q–1Y) multi-asset macro research, daily + 30-minute Chanlun structural analysis, and disciplined portfolio risk execution. The interface rejects marketing theatrics and retail-broker clutter in favor of instrument-grade clarity: dense where quantitative comparison demands scanability, calm and paper-warm where investment-committee theses (thesis.md) require sustained reading.
keyCharacteristics: Strict semantic decoupling: Cobalt interactive accent is reserved exclusively for actions, active navigation, and focus states.
Tonal layering over heavy shadows: Depth comes from stepped obsidian/slate luminance planes and hairline borders.
Micro-radius precision: Crisp 4px–10px corner geometry distinguishes read-only badges, interactive controls, tables, and workspace panels.
Tabular numerical discipline: Prices, percentages, stop distances, and risk budgets always render in monospace with tabular-nums.
Paper-grade thesis reading: Long-form research memos sit inside a 72ch measure with 1.8 line-height.

rules.name: The Decoupled Cobalt Rule
rules.body: Cobalt (primary) communicates interaction and focus only; green/red/amber communicate market direction and risk only. Never color a neutral action button green or use cobalt to imply a bullish call.

rules.name: The Dual-Theme Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Every foreground token—including muted metadata and tinted semantic badges—must hold at least 4.5:1 contrast against every surface it can sit on in both Obsidian Dark and Crisp Slate Light.

rules.name: The Zero-Hardcoded-Palette Rule
rules.body: UI components reference semantic CSS custom properties and never hardcode Tailwind utility hues like text-amber-400 or border-amber-500/60.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No legible UI text—especially Chinese characters or financial numerals—may drop below 11px (0.6875rem).

rules.name: The No-Uppercase-CJK-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Never apply uppercase tracking-wider eyebrow kickers above section headings or Chinese labels.

rules.name: The Tabular Monospace Rule
rules.body: Monospace is strictly functional—used for tickers, prices, dates, percentages, R-multiples, and code identifiers.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Cards Rule
rules.body: Never nest .card inside .card or wrap KPI cells in individual bordered boxes inside a card.

rules.name: The Single-Elevation-Source Rule
rules.body: Overlay containers define their positioning, border, and shadow once in CSS; never stack conflicting shadow utilities.

rules.name: The No-Side-Tab-Bar Rule
rules.body: Never place a thick one-sided accent bar along the edge of a rounded card, callout, or blockquote.

dos: Do keep Cobalt (primary) strictly for interactive controls, active tabs, and focus rings, and reserve green/red/amber solely for market direction and sentinel risk.
Do validate every text/surface combination against WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1) in both Obsidian Dark and Crisp Slate Light using npx @google/design.md lint DESIGN.md.
Do use 11px (0.6875rem) as the hard minimum font size across all badges, chart legends, table headers, and metadata.
Do format all prices, percentages, stop distances, and risk figures with font-mono and tabular-nums (.tnum / td.num).
Do ensure every clickable card, table row, SVG data point, and composite input has full keyboard focus (:focus-visible / :focus-within) and Enter/Space handling.
Do use .metric-strip and .card-subtle for internal hierarchy inside panels instead of stacking bordered cards inside cards.
donts: Don't put thick one-sided accent bars (border-l-[3px], border-inline-start: 3px solid) on rounded cards, callouts, or blockquotes.
Don't hardcode Tailwind color utilities (text-amber-400, border-amber-500/60, bg-blue-500) in components; always consume semantic CSS tokens.
Don't put decorative trailing arrows (→) inside CTA buttons or uppercase tracking-wider eyebrow kickers above Chinese headings.
Don't stack opacity-45/opacity-60 on already-muted text (text-muted), which collapses contrast well below WCAG AA.
Don't mix rounded-full filter pills with 6px .chip controls or bypass .data-table / .btn / .input primitives without an explicit domain reason.
Don't use decorative gradients, gratuitous page-load animations, or emojis as replacement icons when lucide-react strokes belong there.
